_note: FL12 fragment. flags: one full record per index of D4 that a chest record or a hidden_red_jewel placement reaches (46 chest flags $0201-$022E, 16 jewel flags $0280-$028F). No spine flags: every index of the range has users in one scene only. The old trace barrier_chest_flags (46 candidates $0201-$022E) is the chest list; there is no barrier table.

D4.name: chests and hidden Red Jewels
D4.lifecycle: Bytes $0A40-$0A5F of the save block; no scene load, world-map entry or game over clears them (ClearSceneState zeroes only $0A00-$0A01, ClearAllWramFlags only $0A80-$0A9F) and no clear wrapper exists for the _0200 base, so a set bit stays for the life of the save. Chests use $0201-$022E (the record byte AND $7F, so the table can address only $0200-$027F); hidden Red Jewels use $0280-$028F (actor attribute >> 1 plus $80); the two ranges cannot collide. The other 194 indices have no reader and no writer.
D4.access: TestEventFlag_0200 (PlaceOpenedChestTiles, RadarPlotSceneMarkers, HiddenRedJewelInteract) and SetEventFlag_0200 (HandleChestInteraction twice, HiddenRedJewelInteract); no COP literal, no direct byte access and no other helper reaches $0200-$02FF.
